name: building
description: Urban and rural buildings with an immediate point of interest

fields.Name: Blacksmith
fields.Description: a hot stone workshop taking commissions while quietly repairing forbidden weapons.

fields.Name: Public Bathhouse
fields.Description: tiled pools, rented lockers, gossiping attendants, and discreet meeting rooms.

fields.Name: Brothel
fields.Description: a guarded, professionally run house offering companionship, information, and strict privacy.

fields.Name: Temple
fields.Description: a public sanctuary with an altar, charitable kitchen, archives, and restricted crypt.

fields.Name: Apothecary
fields.Description: fragrant shelves of remedies, poisons, preserved creatures, and mislabeled experiments.

fields.Name: Guildhall
fields.Description: offices, training spaces, a contract board, and a members-only meeting chamber.

fields.Name: Warehouse
fields.Description: stacked cargo, overhead walkways, night watchmen, and one shipment missing from the ledger.

fields.Name: Theater
fields.Description: ornate public seating, cramped backstage passages, workshops, and hidden royal boxes.

fields.Name: Schoolhouse
fields.Description: a single crowded classroom whose teacher knows every family secret in the district.

fields.Name: Mill
fields.Description: a water- or wind-powered workplace surrounded by dust, noise, laborers, and moving machinery.

fields.Name: Courthouse
fields.Description: public hearing chamber, evidence rooms, legal archives, and judges' private offices.

fields.Name: Wizard's Tower
fields.Description: an eccentric vertical residence whose rooms do not follow exterior dimensions.

fields.Name: Embassy
fields.Description: a fortified noble residence operating under foreign laws and constant surveillance.

fields.Name: Observatory
fields.Description: a domed hilltop laboratory tracking stars, weather, and something approaching from above.

fields.Name: Abandoned Manor
fields.Description: a decaying estate left furnished after its occupants vanished during dinner.

fields.Name: Underground Fighting Pit
fields.Description: a concealed arena with betting rooms, healers, cages, and bribed officials.

fields.Name: Municipal Museum
fields.Description: A poorly guarded local collection contains an object whose official origin is false.

fields.Name: Library
fields.Description: The most-read books all lack the same page, while a sealed shelf still seems visited.

fields.Name: General Store
fields.Description: A cluttered shop whose owner knows visitors’ needs before they voice them.

fields.Name: Barracks
fields.Description: A tense garrison hides the repeated disappearance of its sentries.

fields.Name: Armory
fields.Description: A secure workshop sells and repairs weapons but conceals the origin of a prestigious order.

fields.Name: Town Hall
fields.Description: Municipal records contradict residents’ memories of an entire district.

fields.Name: Tavern
fields.Description: A noisy establishment trading rumors, contracts, and messages for absent clients.

fields.Name: Restaurant
fields.Description: A celebrated kitchen depends on a rare ingredient whose supply has stopped.

fields.Name: Inn
fields.Description: Simple rooms surround a common hall where travelers and residents exchange news and suspicions.

fields.Name: Town House
fields.Description: An attached home hides rooms whose windows do not match its facade.

fields.Name: Isolated Farm
fields.Description: Crops flourish in sterile soil, and the family refuses every inspection.

fields.Name: Public Park
fields.Description: At night, statues, kiosks, and paths form a different plan from the one seen by day.

fields.Name: Walled Garden
fields.Description: Rare plants thrive around a greenhouse that officially has no keyholder.

fields.Name: Bank
fields.Description: Guarded and sealed vaults also hold deposits their owners want forgotten.

fields.Name: Monumental Fountain
fields.Description: Offerings thrown into the water reappear in strangers’ pockets.

fields.Name: Public Square
fields.Description: Markets, proclamations, and protests compete beneath a controversial monument.

fields.Name: Church
fields.Description: An active congregation maintains a place of worship whose crypt predates the city.

fields.Name: Cathedral
fields.Description: A vast spiritual and political institution keeps jealously guarded relics.

fields.Name: Great Gate
fields.Description: The city’s main entrance concentrates guards, taxes, stranded travelers, and suspicious goods.

fields.Name: Bakery and Pastry Shop
fields.Description: The communal oven has burned without fuel for nights and draws visitors after closing.

fields.Name: Butcher and Delicatessen
fields.Description: The shop receives unusual meat from a supplier absent from every record.

fields.Name: Craft Workshop
fields.Description: A cramped workshop makes a remarkable object at the cost of time or a rare material.

fields.Name: Stable
fields.Description: Mounts, grooms, and travelers surround an animal no one can approach.

fields.Name: Manor
fields.Description: A prestigious residence gathers servants, guests, and heirs around a family secret.

fields.Name: Prison
fields.Description: The administration insists a cell occupied for years has never existed.

fields.Name: Secondhand Shop
fields.Description: Ordinary objects mingle with stolen keepsakes and relics whose true function the seller ignores.

fields.Name: Tenement
fields.Description: Many households share stairs, a courtyard, and disputes around a bricked-up apartment.

fields.Name: Dump
fields.Description: Salvagers search heaps of waste around an object slowly transforming nearby materials.

fields.Name: Mechanical Scrapyard
fields.Description: Machine and vehicle wrecks supply parts to an intensely protective mechanic.
